tasks.title: Announcement #2
tasks.instruction: Listen to a principal talking to a group of students.
tasks.transcript: I need to tell you again that your behavior on Wednesday's field trip will determine whether or not you can go to the Redwood Forest. If you behave on Wednesday, you will be able to go to the Redwood Forest in June with the rest of your classmates. If not, you'll be staying at school with me.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the talk?

options.A: The class trip to the Redwood Forest
options.B: Students misbehaving at the Redwood Forest
options.C: The students choosing to go on Wednesday 's trip
options.D: The students’ behavior affecting their trip to Redwood Forest

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问这段讲话的主要话题，属于主旨/话题识别题，需抓住校长整段话的核心内容。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 讲话中提到红木森林之旅，但这只是结果部分，并非核心话题。 选项B：错误。 校长强调的是未来行为对资格的影响，并未提及学生过去在红木森林表现不佳。 选项C：错误。 周三的实地考察是评估行为的机会，而非让学生选择是否参加。 选项D：正确。 校长明确说“your behavior on Wednesday's field trip will determine whether or not you can go to the Redwood Forest”，整段话围绕学生的行为将决定他们能否参加红木森林之旅。

questions.stem: What does principal imply about Wednesday’s field trip?

options.A: Some of the students can not go, but stay at school.
options.B: Only the students who behave well at school can attend it.
options.C: It will be led by principal.
options.D: The students’ behavior in it will be supervised.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问校长关于周三实地考察的暗示，属于推理判断题，需抓住校长讲话中的隐含信息。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 校长说如果学生在周三表现不好，六月就要留在学校，但并未说明周三的实地考察本身有人不能参加。 选项B：错误。 校长说的是周三实地考察的行为决定六月旅行的资格，而非在学校的行为决定周三考察的资格。 选项C：错误。 校长提到表现不好的学生要留在学校和他在一起，但并未说明周三的实地考察由他带队。 选项D：正确。 校长明确说周三实地考察的行为将决定六月旅行的资格，暗示周三的行为会被监督和评估。
